name: Eolas Prints
summary: Spanish filament manufacturer in Cantabria (founded 2015, first PLA product 2017) claiming in-house production under ISO 9001/14001, positioned around certified filaments for industrial users. Sells PLA on NatureWorks Ingeo 850/870 grades plus silk, matte and high-speed PLA, flexible TPU grades, ABS, ASA and PETG, in 1.75 and 2.85 mm.

product_lines.name: PLA (Ingeo 850 / 870)
product_lines.notes: Built on NatureWorks Ingeo 3D850/3D870 grades; 2.85 mm also offered. Not mapped to pla-ht because the notes do not state an annealing/high-heat claim.

product_lines.name: Flex TPU D53
product_lines.notes: 53D semi-rigid TPU; no exact id (tpu-55d is the nearest but not equivalent).

additional_notes: Registered in the Mercantile Register of Cantabria, VAT ESB39813605; town not stated. A 2022 investor from Oxford, UK became an (unnamed) shareholder, which is not a brand relationship. An unrelated 'Eolas (Ireland)' appears in a research registry with no evidence of connection. No white-label relationships found. Price tier not verified.

provenance.conflicts: In-house production and ISO certifications are the company's own claims (materials catalogue), echoed by 3Dnatives; legal form and exact town not stated.
